verses.greek: Τεκνία μου, ταῦτα γράφω ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ ἁμάρτητε. καὶ ἐάν τις ἁμάρτῃ, παράκλητον ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν δίκαιον,
verses.literal: Little children of mine these things I am writing to you so that not you may sin And if anyone shall sin an advocate we have with the Father Jesus Christ the Righteous One
verses.dgt: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. And if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.

verses.greek: καὶ αὐτὸς ἱλασμός ἐστιν περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν, οὐ περὶ τῶν ἡμετέρων δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ ὅλου τοῦ κόσμου.
verses.literal: And He himself the propitiation is for the sins of us not for those of ourselves and only but also for all the world.
verses.dgt: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only but also for the whole world.

verses.greek: Καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐγνώκαμεν αὐτόν, ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν.
verses.literal: And by this we know that we have come to know Him if the commandments of Him we shall keep.
verses.dgt: And by this we know that we have come to know him: if we keep his commandments.

verses.greek: ὁ λέγων ὅτι Ἔγνωκα αὐτὸν καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ μὴ τηρῶν ψεύστης ἐστίν, καὶ ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀλήθεια οὐκ ἔστιν·
verses.literal: The one saying that I have known Him and the commandments of Him not keeping a liar he is and in him the truth not is
verses.dgt: The one who says, “I know him,” and does not keep his commandments is a liar, and the truth is not in that person.

verses.greek: ὃς δʼ ἂν τηρῇ αὐτοῦ τὸν λόγον, ἀληθῶς ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ τετελείωται. ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐσμεν·
verses.literal: Whoever however maybe may keep His the word truly in him the love the of God has been perfected. By this we know that in Him we are.
verses.dgt: But whoever keeps his word, truly in that person the love of God has been brought to completion. By this we know that we are in him.

verses.greek: ὁ λέγων ἐν αὐτῷ μένειν ὀφείλει καθὼς ἐκεῖνος περιεπάτησεν καὶ αὐτὸς περιπατεῖν.
verses.literal: The one claiming in Him to abide ought even as that one walked also He himself to walk.
verses.dgt: The one who says that he remains in him ought also to walk just as he walked.

verses.greek: Ἀγαπητοί, οὐκ ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν, ἀλλʼ ἐντολὴν παλαιὰν ἣν εἴχετε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· ἡ ἐντολὴ ἡ παλαιά ἐστιν ὁ λόγος ὃν ἠκούσατε.
verses.literal: Beloved not a commandment new I am writing to you but a commandment old which you have had from the beginning The commandment the old is the word that you have heard
verses.dgt: Beloved, I am not writing a new commandment to you, but an old commandment that you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word that you heard.

verses.greek: πάλιν ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν, ὅ ἐστιν ἀληθὲς ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία παράγεται καὶ τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινὸν ἤδη φαίνει.
verses.literal: Again a commandment new I am writing to you which is true in Him and in you because the darkness is passing away and the light the true already shines.
verses.dgt: Yet I am writing a new commandment to you, something that is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light is already shining.

verses.greek: ὁ λέγων ἐν τῷ φωτὶ εἶναι καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ μισῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν ἕως ἄρτι.
verses.literal: The one claiming in the light to be and the brother of him hating in the darkness is until now.
verses.dgt: The one who says he is in the light while hating his brother is still in the darkness.

verses.greek: ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ μένει, καὶ σκάνδαλον ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν·
verses.literal: The one loving the brother of him in the light abides and cause for stumbling in him not there is.
verses.dgt: The one who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause for stumbling in him.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ μισῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν καὶ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ περιπατεῖ, καὶ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία ἐτύφλωσεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: The one however hating the brother of him in the darkness is and in the darkness walks and not does he know where he is going because the darkness has blinded the eyes of him.
verses.dgt: But the one who hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness, and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

verses.greek: Γράφω ὑμῖν, τεκνία, ὅτι ἀφέωνται ὑμῖν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι διὰ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ·
verses.literal: I am writing to you little children because have been forgiven your the sins for the sake of the name of Him.
verses.dgt: I write to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven you because of his name.

verses.greek: γράφω ὑμῖν, πατέρες, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· γράφω ὑμῖν, νεανίσκοι, ὅτι νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν.
verses.literal: I am writing to you fathers because you have known Him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you young men because you have overcome the evil one.
verses.dgt: I write to you, fathers, because you have known the one who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one.

verses.greek: ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, παιδία, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν πατέρα· ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, πατέρες, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, νεανίσκοι, ὅτι ἰσχυροί ἐστε καὶ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν μένει καὶ νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν.
verses.literal: 14 I have written to you παιδία, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν πατέρα· ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, fathers because you have known Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you young men because strong you are and the word the of God in you abides and you have overcome the evil one.
verses.dgt: I have written to you, children, because you have known the Father. I have written to you, fathers, because you have known the one who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

verses.greek: Μὴ ἀγαπᾶτε τὸν κόσμον μηδὲ τὰ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ. ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ τὸν κόσμον, οὐκ ἔστιν ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ πατρὸς ἐν αὐτῷ·
verses.literal: Not do love the world nor the things in the world. If anyone shall love the world not is the love of the Father in him
verses.dgt: Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

verses.greek: ὅτι πᾶν τὸ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ ἡ ἀλαζονεία τοῦ βίου, οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ πατρός, ἀλλὰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐστίν·
verses.literal: because all that is in the world the desire of the flesh and the desire of the eyes and the vaunting the of life not is from the Father but from the world is.
verses.dgt: For everything in the world—the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but is from the world.

verses.greek: καὶ ὁ κόσμος παράγεται καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία αὐτοῦ, ὁ δὲ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
verses.literal: And the world is passing away and the desire of it the one however doing the will the of God abides to the age.
verses.dgt: And the world is passing away, along with its desire, but the one who does the will of God remains forever.

verses.greek: Παιδία, ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν, καὶ καθὼς ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἀντίχριστος ἔρχεται, καὶ νῦν ἀντίχριστοι πολλοὶ γεγόνασιν· ὅθεν γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν.
verses.literal: Little children the last hour it is and even as you have heard that antichrist is coming even now antichrists many have arisen whereby we know that the last hour it is.
verses.dgt: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you heard that antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have appeared. From this we know that it is the last hour.

verses.greek: ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐξῆλθαν, ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἦσαν ἐξ ἡμῶν· εἰ γὰρ ἐξ ἡμῶν ἦσαν, μεμενήκεισαν ἂν μεθʼ ἡμῶν· ἀλλʼ ἵνα φανερωθῶσιν ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν πάντες ἐξ ἡμῶν.
verses.literal: From among us they went out but not they were of us if for of us they were being they had remained then would with us But it is so that it may be made manifest that not they are all of us.
verses.dgt: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have remained with us. But this happened so that it might become clear that not all are of us.

verses.greek: καὶ ὑμεῖς χρῖσμα ἔχετε ἀπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ οἴδατε πάντες·
verses.literal: And you yourselves the anointing have from the Holy One and you know all you.
verses.dgt: And you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all know.

verses.greek: οὐκ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἀλήθειαν, ἀλλʼ ὅτι οἴδατε αὐτήν, καὶ ὅτι πᾶν ψεῦδος ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἔστιν.
verses.literal: Not I have written to you because not you know the truth but because you know it and because any lie of the truth not is.
verses.dgt: I have not written to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie comes from the truth.

verses.greek: τίς ἐστιν ὁ ψεύστης εἰ μὴ ὁ ἀρνούμενος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ χριστός; οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἀντίχριστος, ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὸν υἱόν.
verses.literal: who is the liar only except the one denying that Jesus not is the Christ? This is the antichrist the one denying the Father and the Son.
verses.dgt: Who is the liar except the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist—the one who denies the Father and the Son.

verses.greek: πᾶς ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν υἱὸν οὐδὲ τὸν πατέρα ἔχει· ὁ ὁμολογῶν τὸν υἱὸν καὶ τὸν πατέρα ἔχει.
verses.literal: Everyone who is denying the Son neither the Father has he The one confessing the Son also the Father has.
verses.dgt: Everyone who denies the Son does not have the Father either; the one who confesses the Son has the Father also.

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς ὃ ἠκούσατε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ἐν ὑμῖν μενέτω· ἐὰν ἐν ὑμῖν μείνῃ ὃ ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς ἠκούσατε, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν τῷ υἱῷ καὶ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ μενεῖτε.
verses.literal: You yourselves what you have heard from the beginning in you should abide. If in you shall abide what from the beginning you have heard also you yourselves in the Son and in the Father will abide.
verses.dgt: As for you, let what you heard from the beginning remain in you. If what you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.

verses.greek: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐπαγγελία ἣν αὐτὸς ἐπηγγείλατο ἡμῖν, τὴν ζωὴν τὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.literal: And this is the promise that He himself promised us: the life the eternal.
verses.dgt: And this is the promise that he himself promised us: eternal life.

verses.greek: Ταῦτα ἔγραψα ὑμῖν περὶ τῶν πλανώντων ὑμᾶς.
verses.literal: These things I have written to you concerning those leading astray you.
verses.dgt: I have written these things to you concerning those who are trying to lead you astray.

verses.greek: καὶ ὑμεῖς τὸ χρῖσμα ὃ ἐλάβετε ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ μένει ἐν ὑμῖν, καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε ἵνα τις διδάσκῃ ὑμᾶς· ἀλλʼ ὡς τὸ αὐτοῦ χρῖσμα διδάσκει ὑμᾶς περὶ πάντων, καὶ ἀληθές ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ψεῦδος, καὶ καθὼς ἐδίδαξεν ὑμᾶς, μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ.
verses.literal: And you yourselves the anointing that you received from Him abides in you and not need you have that anyone may teach you But just as the same anointing teaches you concerning all things and true is and not is a lie and even as it has taught you you abide in Him.
verses.dgt: And as for you, the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you have no need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about all things, and is true and is not a lie, just as it taught you, remain in him.

verses.greek: Καὶ νῦν, τεκνία, μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ, ἵνα ἐὰν φανερωθῇ σχῶμεν παρρησίαν καὶ μὴ αἰσχυνθῶμεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: And now little children do abide in Him so that if He shall appear we may have boldness and not may be ashamed before Him at the coming of Him.
verses.dgt: And now, little children, remain in him, so that when he is revealed we may have confidence and not shrink from him in shame at his coming.

verses.greek: ἐὰν εἰδῆτε ὅτι δίκαιός ἐστιν, γινώσκετε ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν δικαιοσύνην ἐξ αὐτοῦ γεγέννηται.
verses.literal: If you know that righteous He is you know that everyone who is practicing the righteousness of Him has been begotten.
verses.dgt: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born from him.
